title: Batch 1 — first renders (30 Sep)
notes: The first 30 s experiment and the first 60 s demo. Both predate later fixes.

title: Batch 2 — shapes after references (1 Oct)
notes: Ten cuts shaped after genre Shorts, label previews (NineTimesNine, SNTS) and two of the audio references, plus the fixed 60 s demo. Re-rendered to remove a glitch in the first second. Re-trimmed onto the grid on 1 Oct (they had started about 0.9 s early).

title: Batch 3 — hat progressions, all under 40 s (1 Oct)
notes: Each cut climbs through the song's own layering: the hats and percussion step up every few bars instead of holding one level. Re-trimmed onto the grid on 1 Oct (they had started about 0.9 s early).

title: Batch 4 — longer, on the grid, hats that stack (1 Oct)
notes: Answers the first commute feedback: 36–48 s, sections of 4 or 8 bars, a longer scoop, hats added one layer at a time without dropping any, a longer pre-kick sound, and drop-outs before the kick.

title: Batch 4.1 — track 1 earlier, track 2's beatbox fixed, splash lengths (2 Oct)
notes: Tracks 1–3 bring track 1's excitement forward. Tracks 4–7 play track 2's beatbox phrase once, with its final wuh stretched x2, x1.5, x1 and x3, ending at the silence before the kick. Tracks 8–10 compare splash lengths of 6, 8 and 3 beats against the whole-note splash used elsewhere.

groups.label: Batch 4's track 1, brought earlier
groups.say: Same opening. Each layer arrives sooner.

groups.label: Batch 4's track 2, the beatbox ending
groups.say: The beatbox phrase plays once. Only the stretch on its last wuh changes.

groups.label: Splash length at the drop
groups.say: Each one against the whole-note splash used elsewhere.

title: Batch 4.2 — the wuh, the silence and the drop on the grid; a louder drop (2 Oct)
notes: Tracks 1–6 try different grids for the beatbox wuh, the silence and the kick: the wuh on the bar, wuh plus 8th or 16th chops of its last part, a long wuh from bar 11, a long wuh plus chops, and a 2-beat silence. The breakdown sounds stay in, 4 dB quieter so the drop stands out (6 dB in track 7). Splash: 8 beats at the drop, 3 beats on later section downbeats. Tracks 8 and 10 stop the hats at three layers. Tracks 9–10 open on a 4-bar scoop kick.

title: Batch 4.3 — fewer splashes (6 Oct)
notes: Four versions that change only the splashes. Kick, rumble, splash and hats play. Each one starts on the scooped kick. Batch 4.2 had a splash on every section. Here there are fewer of them, or only short ones.

title: Batch 4.4 — the hats (6 Oct)
notes: Five versions that change only the hats. Kick, rumble and hats play, with no splashes. Tracks one and two are batch 4's numbers 7 and 9. Tracks three to five leave out the quiet ride.

title: Batch 5 — six mix changes, tuned toward the references (6 Oct)
notes: Each track plays the drop twice: as mixed, then with one change. Both halves are equally loud. A program tuned each change toward the four Bandcamp references. It stops when ten rounds in a row find nothing better. This page updates when a change improves.
